chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one whom he mentioned, said:
I said to Abī al-Hasan عليه السلام: May I be made your ransom, a mutamatti' visited the House and performed the tawaf of hajj, then performed Tawaf al-Nisa', then performed sa'y.
So he said: The sa'y is not to be except before Tawaf al-Nisa'.
So I said: Is anything due upon him? He said: There is no sa'y except before Tawaf al-Nisa'.

key_terms.السَّعْيُ: the ritual walking between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf after which marital permissibility is restored

ai.seo_question: Must sa'y be performed before Tawaf al-Nisa' in hajj al-tamattu'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the order of rites in hajj al-tamattu'. Imam Abī al-Hasan عليه السلام states that sa'y must come before Tawaf al-Nisa', emphasizing the required sequence of these rites.
